note.version: FINAL 2026-11-13, built against HEMS RANDOM AND EVERYWHERE MISSIONS 0.997 170.26 (HEMS RANDOM AND EVERYWHERE MISSIONS 0.997 170.26)
note.merge: Data part: merge every entry of 'entries' into data[table][index] (apply_patch.py does exactly this). Keys that are not listed stay unchanged; 'vitals' holds the min/max fields to overwrite; 'changed' is for review only. Do NOT ship the merged data without the macro changes in 'implementation': the current macros do not know the new profile names.
note.life_score: scoremin/scoremax/decr_rate as set by the doctor.
note.profiles: 23 profiles, see 'profiles'. Renamed: perfusion_support -> iv_access, respiratory_support -> oxygen_support. New: trauma_check, vasopressor, ecg, pain_relief, immobilise, iv_fluids, intubation, defibrillation, glucose_level, give_glucose, critical_bleeding, tourniquet, acs_therapy, antidote_therapy.

implementation.phase_buttons: Per phase 4 buttons: 1 correct (the next profile of the sequence, random slot as today via manual_p1_correct_slot), 1 plausible-wrong (random profile from the pathology's plausible_wrong_pool, its own wrong outcome), 2 absurd (labels from wrong_button_sets[manual_p1_wrong_set] at their slot positions, penalty life score -2/-5, no vital change). manual_p1_wrong_set = floor(rand(0,10)). Today the 144 static buttons of 'patient health' carry profile-specific wrong labels; they must be replaced (dynamic titles, or one static button per label and slot).
implementation.always_effective: A correct choice always takes effect: add a flag (e.g. medical_action_force_success) to 'apply patientN medical action effect' and one effect block per new profile (values in 'profiles').
implementation.new_locals: Per patient: glucose (rand(glucose_min, glucose_max) mg/dL), ecg_rhythm, critical bleeding YES/NO (rand < critical_bleeding_chance). Set at initialisation, include in snapshot/restore and save slots.
implementation.report_steps: ecg, glucose_level, critical_bleeding, trauma_check write their result into P{n}_MANUAL_ACTION_RESULT_n, e.g. 'ECG: VF', 'Glucose 48 mg/dL', 'Critical bleeding: YES', 'Trauma check done'.
implementation.tourniquet: The tourniquet/chest seal step directly after CRIT BLEEDING CHK is skipped (phase advances, no error) when the check returned NO. If the chance is 0 the check always reports NO; a following CONTROL BLEEDING step is NOT skipped.
implementation.defibrillation: Correct only for ecg_rhythm VF or pVT; success sets rhythm SINUS (ROSC).
implementation.allergic_support: ADRENALINE is correct for allergies (first step), ecg BRADYCARDIA with HR < 46 and PEA/asystole. Effect: anaphylaxis as before; bradycardia HR toward 60-80; PEA/asystole with CPR running life score +1-2 and 20 % ROSC chance (draft).
implementation.give_glucose: If glucose < 60 mg/dL: GCS set to E4 V4 M6 (14) and glucose to 90-120 mg/dL.
implementation.antidote_therapy: New profile (button ANTIDOTE): opioid/benzodiazepine intoxications. Effect when correct: SpO2 +4-6, HR toward 60-100, GCS set to 13. As plausible-wrong: life score -4/-11.
implementation.neurological_support: GCS & PUPILS no longer changes GCS or vitals.
implementation.arrest_monitor: Arrest pathologies have no ECG step: show the rhythm (VF, pVT, PEA, ASYSTOLE) on the monitor from the start.
implementation.automatic_when_no_steps: Transport missions without a patient (healthsecondary 17-23, manual_treatment 'automatic', medical_action_count 0) always use the automatic medical decision mode. Add a helper that returns 'manual' only if P1_MANUAL_MEDICAL_MODE eq 'manual' AND P{n}_MEDICAL_ACTION_COUNT > 0; use it where P1_MANUAL_MEDICAL_MODE is checked today (patient health, request manual patient visit, crew physical HEMS assessment, multipatient registry crew clinical completion, select patient1 transport, stabilize medical patient for transport; P2/P3 copies).
implementation.unchanged: PERSIST_MISSION_WAIT_TIME, the error counter manual_p1_error_count and the random slot of the correct answer stay as they are.
implementation.macro_copies: The manual-treatment macros exist three times (patients 1-3, 11 families, about 93 KB); write one template and generate all three.
